mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the sliding window quilt was most worthwhile: the immediate reduction in cold and the ability to uncover the window made the solution easy to understand.

leastWorthwhile.text: Straightening the antenna was straightforward but less engaging on its own; mounting it and hearing the message gave it more significance.

surprise.text: The twelve-minute-old message made the delay in communicating with Earth tangible and made me curious about Mara's eventual reply.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. Charging the battery was the only available combination at that point, but its purpose was clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to hear Mara's reply and see how the expedition develops, and the practical cabin preparations have been satisfying.
